definition: A way to declare what type a value should have, like `name: string` or `count: number`.
A named description of an object shape (which properties exist and their types).
A named type, often used to create unions or reusable type definitions (e.g., `type Id = string | number`).
A type that allows one of multiple options, written with `|` like `string | number`.
A tool that checks TypeScript types and reports errors before code runs as JavaScript.
